نتصافح (form VI)
# نَتَصَافَحُ (nataṣāfaḥu) /na.ta.sˤaː.fa.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَصَافَحَ (taṣāfaḥa)
# نَتَصَافَحَ (nataṣāfaḥa) /na.ta.sˤaː.fa.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَصَافَحَ (taṣāfaḥa)
# نَتَصَافَحْ (nataṣāfaḥ) /na.ta.sˤaː.faħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَصَافَحَ (taṣāfaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
